description: Tape summary for ONE Polymarket outcome token: recorded events (`total_events`), `trades`, `trade_volume` in outcome SHARES (not USD), `snapshots`, and the first / last recorded timestamps (`first_ms` / `last_ms`, epoch ms). `token_id` is the ERC-1155 OUTCOME token id (decimal string from `clob_token_ids` in polymarket_market_detail or `outcomes[].token_id` in polymarket_markets); a condition_id (0x...) will NOT work. Always returns ONE row: a token that was never recorded answers all zeros with total_events = 0, which means 'never recorded', not 'quiet'.

token_id.description: Required. The outcome token id (decimal string).

name: polymarket_market_stats
title: Polymarket Market Stats
